summary.text: Kevin Vaughan is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 95 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Vaughan assumed office representing Tennessee House District 95 in 2017.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Commerce Committee and a member of the Calendar and Rules and Health committees.
